invariants.rationale: The method always returns either the input records or a sorted version of the same; it never returns null.
In both branches (records.isEmpty() or not), the returned list is the same instance as the input 'records'.
The method never adds or removes elements from the list; it only sorts it if not empty.
For safety, expressing that if outputPartitions is non-positive but records are empty, result is the same as records.
The emptiness of the input and result is always the same; sorting does not affect emptiness.
